what.text: This page follows refugees from Venezuela living in Canada, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 4585 Venezuelan refugees in Canada, 1.1% of all refugees from Venezuela.
The largest numbers of Venezuelan refugees live in Spain, Brazil, the United States and Mexico.

why.text: UCDP records one armed conflict for Venezuela: over the government, with a military faction, in 1992.
The fact pack does not give reasons why people left Venezuela in recent years.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1994 at 363 refugees.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2019 to 2021 and 2024 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Canada.
These are year-end totals for Canada only, reported to UNHCR.
